title.psn: Where do I make my PSN profile public?
title.steam: Where do I make my Steam profile public?
title.xbox: Where do I make my Xbox history public?
title.epic: Where do I make my Epic Games profile public?

psn: From the console (PS5/PS4): Settings → Users and Accounts → Privacy → Customize.
Find "Trophy Level, Games, and Showcases" (or "Trophies") and set it to "Anyone" / "Everyone".
If you'd rather do it from your phone: PlayStation app → your profile → settings icon → Account Privacy → Trophies.
The change is instant — no need to restart your session or wait.
steam: Go to your Steam profile (web or client) → "Edit Profile" → "Privacy Settings".
This is the one almost everyone misses: set "Game Details" to Public TOO — without it, Steam won't let us read your library even if your profile is already public.
Click "Save Changes" at the bottom of the page.
xbox: On the console or in the Xbox app: your profile → "Online safety & privacy" → "View details & customize".
Find "Game history and compare" (or "Share content") and set it to "Everyone".
Xbox uses an unofficial third-party service (OpenXBL) to read this — if your profile is already public and it's still not working, it's not your setting, try again later.
epic: In the Epic Games Store (web or launcher): click your avatar top right → "My Achievements".
Top right of your achievements page, click "Privacy Level" and choose "Public".
Copy the link from that same page (it ends in /u/ followed by a code) and paste it here.
